tempF.label: Mean temperature
tempF.say: the mean temperature of the year, the average of NOAA's twelve monthly means (worked out here)

tempMaxF.label: Mean daily high
tempMaxF.say: the mean of the days' highest temperatures in the year, the average of NOAA's twelve monthly means (worked out here)

tempMinF.label: Mean daily low
tempMinF.say: the mean of the days' lowest temperatures in the year, the average of NOAA's twelve monthly means (worked out here)

precipIn.label: Precipitation
precipIn.say: rain and snow in the year, in inches of water: the sum of NOAA's twelve monthly totals (worked out here)

heatingDD.label: Heating degree-days
heatingDD.say: how far, and for how many days, the day's mean fell below 65 °F - the need for heating - summed over NOAA's twelve months (worked out here)

coolingDD.label: Cooling degree-days
coolingDD.say: how far, and for how many days, the day's mean rose above 65 °F - the need for cooling - summed over NOAA's twelve months (worked out here)

pdsi.label: Palmer Drought Severity Index
pdsi.say: NOAA's drought index, the average of its twelve months (worked out here): 0 normal; -2 moderate, -3 severe, -4 extreme drought; the same above 0 for wet spells

droughtMonths.label: Months in drought
droughtMonths.say: months of the year with a Palmer index of -2.0 or lower - moderate drought or worse, NOAA's category - counted here

pm25.label: Fine-particle pollution (PM2.5)
pm25.say: people's mean exposure over the year to fine particles, PM2.5, in micrograms per cubic metre of air

pm25AboveWho.label: People above the WHO guideline
pm25AboveWho.say: the share of people exposed to more fine-particle pollution than the World Health Organization's guideline

aqiGood.label: Good days
aqiGood.say: days of the year the Air Quality Index was good (0-50)

aqiSensitive.label: Unhealthy for sensitive groups
aqiSensitive.say: days it was unhealthy for sensitive groups (101-150)

aqiMedian.label: Median Air Quality Index
aqiMedian.say: the median of the year's daily Air Quality Index readings

aqiMax.label: Highest Air Quality Index
aqiMax.say: the year's highest daily Air Quality Index reading

noaa.label: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information - nClimDiv
noaa.note: Release of 2026-11-05. Station records set on a 5 km grid and averaged over the state or county, by the month; the year's figure is worked out here from its twelve months, in NOAA's own units (°F, inches).

epa.label: US EPA - AirData, annual Air Quality Index summaries
epa.note: The Environmental Protection Agency's yearly summaries of each county's and metropolitan area's daily Air Quality Index, from its monitors: a place with no monitor has no figure, and a year's days are those it was measured.
